description:
Friendship, love, and a whole lot of confusion! Five years after moving away, Dongha finds himself reunited with his two childhood friends. But why have they changed so much? Resident troublemaker Juri has become a refined lady, and the sweet and lovely Dabin is now a cynical recluse. Things are about to get complicated between the three...!
